holdout: Five disjoint folds of entire site histories, fixed seed 20261111, no held-out site observations used in fitting
scoring: Exact log probability of each held-out binary detection sequence including NA exclusion, no combinatorial coefficients; report total and per-site held-out log score difference (beta minus constant)
uncertainty: Paired bootstrap over 87 held-out site log-score differences, 1999 draws, fixed seed 20261112; descriptive percentile interval, not independent confirmation
integrity: fit both models only on training sites
scope: Predictive discrimination of statistical likelihoods for new sites in this example, not verified causal BAM or future external transfer; same source already explored.
